relations.rationale: Ranking position in a tournament is unrelated to how many seasons someone has debated.
Cleo's ranking position has no bearing on when scores were tallied.
Dev not being in Ivo's study group is unrelated to whether Bo is in Ivo's study group.
Study group membership of Dev and Ivo has no bearing on Ivo's age relative to others.
Study group membership is unrelated to when scores were tallied.
